scenicChapters.title: Norwegian Scenic Route Hardanger
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 26 km. 1245 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall. A steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Norwegian Scenic Route Hardangervidda
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 19 km this is Norwegian Scenic Route Hardangervidda, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

scenicChapters.title: Norwegian Scenic Route Hardangervidda
scenicChapters.narrative: 1135 m come off over 23 km at around 6.6%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it — brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.

norwegian-scenic-route-hardangervidda.story: Out of Eidfjord, one way: 85 km, roughly 1 h 24 in the saddle. It goes by way of Mabodalen, Voringsfossen, Dyranut and Halne Fjellstugu. The highest point is about 1,350 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
